grid: Photo half, steel-blue panel half, red bar full height.

offer_placement: Emergency along the rail. A package price in a ticket. Two ideas, the rail clearer.
trust_and_cta: Review chip, phone, code, ticket, and a mascot share the panel.

glance_3s.reason: Glance gets a spring and an emergency.

summary: Mailbox garage card, newer than PM-002. The tool photo is the lesson. The lower panel is a junk drawer.
